## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

Heatmaps

## Planificación y estudio del sitio

**Cubre** todas las **etapas del análisis** de una infraestructura wifi.
Diseño y planificación de cero, a la **evaluación** de una **red** ya **en funcionamiento**.
Pasando por la visualización de los resultados mediante gráficos y **métricas intuitivas** hasta la
generación de los **informes de resultados**.
* **Diseña y planifica** desde cero una red WiFi.
* **Site Survey**, **mapas de calor** de cobertura y calidad de red.
* Identifica y **soluciona** las **zonas problemáticas** de tu infraestructura.
* Genera **informes editables.**, guarda los proyectos y evidencias
* Soporte de **WiFi 7** en todas las bandas de frecuencia

**Y muchas más funcionalidades...**

Diseño Site survey Calidad Informes
Puntos de acceso Dispositivos Calidad Resolución

Analyzer

## Análisis y resolución de problemas

**Analiza** que esta ocurriendo en tu red wifi, **ejecuta métricas** y mide su rendimiento.
**Resuelve incidencias** y obtén **recomendaciones** de mejora.
Diseño sencillo y **fácil **de usar, moderno **e intuitivo** que ayuda a los usuarios menos
experimentados.
* **Analiza** tu red, **identifica** los clientes, mide el **rendimiento**, todo el tiempo real
* **Solución de problemas** y recomendaciones. Olvídate de conexiones lentas.
* Detecta **APs y dispositivos** (Routers, tabletas, teléfonos, portátiles, …)
* Soporte de **WIFI 7** en todas las **bandas de frecuencia**

**Y muchas más funcionalidades...**

[ Descubre Acrylic Wi-Fi Analyzer ][25] [ Comprar licencia ][26]

Sniffer

## Captura de paquetes mejorada

**Captura** todos los **paquetes wifi** enviados por los dispositivos a tu alrededor.
**Analiza** el protocolo y el funcionamiento **a bajo nivel** de las comunicaciones inalambricas.
El **complemento** perfecto para Acrylic Wi-Fi **Analyzer**, **Heatmaps** y **Wireshark**.
* Modo monitor **mejorado**
* Utiliza **hardware económico** y común
* **Integración con terceros**. Usa tu software favorito
* **Sin complicaciones**. No se requiere configuración

**Y muchas más funcionalidades...**

[ Descubre Acrylic Wi-Fi Sniffer ][27] [ Comprar licencia ][28]

#### Los profesionales lo tienen claro:
#### Fácil de usar y con muchas funcionalidades avanzadas.

En todos nuestros almacenes diseñamos los nuevos despliegues wifi con **Acrylic Wi-Fi Heatmaps** y
lo usamos para validar el desempeño periódicamente en todas las instalaciones.

Klaus Andersen

Gestor de instalaciones e ingeniero de redes

Todos nuestros técnicos se apoyan en **Acrylic Wi-Fi Analyzer** para solucionar los problemas que
surgen en las redes inalámbricas de nuestros clientes.

Priya Chopra

Gerente, especialista en redes

Con **Acrylic Wi-Fi Sniffer** hemos podido monitorizar los clientes conectados a nuestras redes
inalámbricas e identificar los problemas de configuración a nivel de protocolo que teniamos.

Alex Miller

Administrador de redes

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# Arteza: Premium Acrylic Paint Sets, Professional Art Markers and Iridescent Pouring Supplies

Whether you’re just starting out or have years of work behind you, Arteza acrylics deliver rich,
vibrant pigments that hold up on canvas, wood, paper, and more — so your work always looks exactly
the way you intended.

[View Collection][17]

### **Rich, Vibrant Pigments**

Arteza acrylics are packed with high-quality pigment, so the colors you see on the palette are the
colors you get on your canvas — bold, saturated, and true to tone even after drying.

### **Works on Almost Any Surface**

Canvas, wood, paper, fabric, rocks — Arteza acrylics stick well to a wide range of surfaces, which
makes them a practical choice for all kinds of projects, not just traditional painting.

### **Great Value for the Price**

You get a lot of paint for the cost. Arteza is known for offering large sets at affordable prices,
which means artists at any budget level can keep creating without constantly running out of
supplies.

Every painting starts with a decision — warm or cool, bold or subtle, chaotic or calm. Pick the
colors that match what you’re feeling and let the work take it from there.

Rich, opaque color in 60 ready-to-use tubes — ideal for both students learning the basics and

96 water-based brush pens with flexible nylon tips packed into a portable organizer case — a go-to

20 acrylic paint markers in assorted colors that work on just about any surface — glass, pottery,
ceramic, plastic, rocks, and canvas — making them a versatile pick for artists who like to paint
beyond the traditional canvas.

[Check Price][21]
[Arteza Metallic Watercolor Paint set of 24 shimmer half pans in metal tin with water brush pen]

### Metallic Watercolor Paint Set, 24 Shimmer Colors

24 shimmer metallic watercolor shades in a sleek metal tin, complete with a water brush pen —
perfect for adding a glowing, reflective touch to lettering, calligraphy, cards, journals, and any
art project that deserves a little shine.

[Check Price][22]
[Arteza 12 Metallic Glitter Watercolor half pans travel set with brush pen]

### Watercolor Paint Set, 12 Metallic Watercolor Paints

A compact travel-friendly set of 12 glittery metallic watercolor shades in half pans — easy to take
anywhere and perfect for adding a sparkling finish to cards, journals, and on-the-go art projects.

[Check Price][23]

## FAQ

#### Are Arteza acrylic paints good for beginners?

Yes. Arteza acrylics are a solid starting point for beginners — they’re easy to work with, come in
large color sets, and are priced reasonably without sacrificing too much on quality.

#### What surfaces can I use Arteza acrylic paint on?

Arteza acrylics work well on canvas, wood, paper, fabric, rocks, ceramic, and more. For best results
on non-porous surfaces like glass or plastic, a primer or sealant is recommended.

#### Are these paints safe to use?

Yes, Arteza acrylic paints are non-toxic and generally safe for adults and older children. Always
check the label and keep them away from very young children.

#### Do Arteza acrylics dry out quickly?

Like most acrylics, they dry faster than oil paints — usually within 20 to 30 minutes depending on
the thickness of the layer and room conditions. Using a stay-wet palette can help keep the paint
workable longer.

#### Do Arteza acrylic paints work for professional artists?

They can hold their own for professional use, especially for artists who go through a lot of paint.
That said, artists who need museum-grade lightfastness may want to supplement with artist-grade
paints for finished pieces meant to last long-term.

#### What’s the difference between Arteza acrylic sets?

Arteza offers sets in different sizes — from compact 12-color sets for travel or beginners, up to
60-color sets for artists who want a full range. Some sets also include metallics, neons, or earth
tones for more specific projects.

## FAQ

#### Are Arteza acrylic paints good for beginners?

Yes. Arteza acrylics are a solid starting point for beginners — they’re easy to work with, come in
large color sets, and are priced reasonably without sacrificing too much on quality.

#### What surfaces can I use Arteza acrylic paint on?

Arteza acrylics work well on canvas, wood, paper, fabric, rocks, ceramic, and more. For best results
on non-porous surfaces like glass or plastic, a primer or sealant is recommended.

#### Are these paints safe to use?

Yes, Arteza acrylic paints are non-toxic and generally safe for adults and older children. Always
check the label and keep them away from very young children.

#### Do Arteza acrylics dry out quickly?

Like most acrylics, they dry faster than oil paints — usually within 20 to 30 minutes depending on
the thickness of the layer and room conditions. Using a stay-wet palette can help keep the paint
workable longer.

#### Do Arteza acrylic paints work for professional artists?

They can hold their own for professional use, especially for artists who go through a lot of paint.
That said, artists who need museum-grade lightfastness may want to supplement with artist-grade
paints for finished pieces meant to last long-term.

#### What’s the difference between Arteza acrylic sets?

Arteza offers sets in different sizes — from compact 12-color sets for travel or beginners, up to
60-color sets for artists who want a full range. Some sets also include metallics, neons, or earth
tones for more specific projects.

# Custom 3-Ring Binders & Printed Binders Proudly Made in America


### Looking for 3-ring binders to fit your exact needs?

Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, Binders Inc. has been creating beautiful **custom 3-ring
binders** and **printed binders** for over 35 years.

From our humble origins producing only binders on an old fashioned press type, to our state-of
the-art facility that now churns out an impressive product line including [index tabs][138], [binder
accessories & options][139], [padfolios][140] and more, Binders Inc. remains a leading supplier of
custom three ring binders made in the USA.

Though much has changed over the years, our commitment to producing a quality product and making our
customers happy is as strong as ever.

We value every customer no matter how large or small and aim to make ordering not only easy, but
enjoyable!

### What's the benefit of custom printed binders?

If you're looking for an unremarkable, run-of-the-mill binder, you can find plenty at an office
supply store near you. However, by purchasing custom 3-ring binders constructed out of high quality
materials, you can ensure longevity of your marketing and office materials, boost the
professionalism of your brand, and give your business a great shot at a strong first impression.

Binders, Inc. specializes in designing and manufacturing durable customized three ring binders that
meets each customer's individual needs (**minimum order of 25 custom binders**), with personalized
artwork, company logo, branding, binder accessories and over 35+ choices of standard color vinyls.
Our fully customizable 3-ring binders come in all shapes and sizes, and are perfect for
presentations, reports, organization, marketing and much more. Contact us to discuss your needs with
a friendly account manager today and [find three-ring binders that fit][141]. **Thank you for
considering us for your project!**

Binders Inc. offers custom three ring binders with excellent quality for general use or
presentation. Personalize your three ring binders with custom artwork, your company logo, or
branding. Our vinyl three ring binders are manufactured with high caliper vinyl, sturdy chipboard
and strong metal rings.We offer various options to customize a three ring vinyl binder that meets
your needs. Choose from over 50 choices of standard color vinyls. Call us for a quality selection of
binders from small 1 inch ring to 3 inch ring binders or more

# Fine Arts


Since 1965, Chroma has created world-class, professional, lightfast acrylic paints and mediums
designed to help artists bring their creative works to life. We are honored that our products play a
part bringing more beauty, clarity and unique visions to the world.

and beginning artists of all ages express this essential truth. All our products are AP-approved,

# A Global Leader in Paints and Coatings

The Sherwin-Williams Company delivers the best in paint and coatings products to the world. Every
day, our more than 64,000 employees provide the energy and experience to build on our track record
of success – enabling us to innovate and grow in new and exciting ways. With our people as the
foundation of our Company, we offer industry-leading innovation, value-added service and expertise,
and differentiated distribution to our growing base of professional, industrial, commercial and
consumer customers.

 

Sherwin-Williams has one of the industry’s most recognized portfolios of branded and private-label
products. The Company’s Sherwin-Williams® branded products are sold exclusively through a chain of
more than 5,000 company operated stores and facilities in the United States, Canada, the Caribbean
and Latin America.

 

Additional brands are sold through leading mass merchandisers, home centers, independent paint
dealers, hardware stores, automotive retailers, and industrial distributors across North America and
in parts of Europe, China, Australia and New Zealand. We also supply a broad range of highly
engineered solutions for the construction, industrial, packaging and transportation markets in more
than 130 countries around the world.

# A Global Leader in Paints and Coatings

The Sherwin-Williams Company delivers the best in paint and coatings products to the world. Every
day, our more than 64,000 employees provide the energy and experience to build on our track record
of success – enabling us to innovate and grow in new and exciting ways. With our people as the
foundation of our Company, we offer industry-leading innovation, value-added service and expertise,
and differentiated distribution to our growing base of professional, industrial, commercial and
consumer customers.

 

Sherwin-Williams has one of the industry’s most recognized portfolios of branded and private-label
products. The Company’s Sherwin-Williams® branded products are sold exclusively through a chain of
more than 5,000 company operated stores and facilities in the United States, Canada, the Caribbean
and Latin America.

 

Additional brands are sold through leading mass merchandisers, home centers, independent paint
dealers, hardware stores, automotive retailers, and industrial distributors across North America and
in parts of Europe, China, Australia and New Zealand. We also supply a broad range of highly
engineered solutions for the construction, industrial, packaging and transportation markets in more
than 130 countries around the world.

[Red Paint] [Cowling and Wilcox Office]

Beginning life in the swinging Soho area of London in 1960, Cowling & Wilcox was born with a simple
ethos in mind; to provide the finest quality specialist materials for fine and graphic art at
exceptional prices.

Over 60 years later & not only are we still devoted to upholding this, but it remains our mission,
even as we expand & evolve into an ever more exciting future!

### Art Supplies & Product Range

[down-arrow.svg]
[up-arrow.svg]

Not only do we supply artists, but we ourselves are proudly creatively minded, meaning that over
these past 60 years, we’ve been on the pulse of trends, while accumulating an impressive wealth of
knowledge & expertise.

We have been stocking products from brands such as Winsor & Newton, Faber-Castell, Da Vinci,
Daler-Rowney & so many more for decades now, working diligently to not only to promote UK art brands
but to reach across the globe & broaden our respective horizons, bringing new materials to the
creative community right here!

On top of all of that, our range of materials is ever-growing, so no matter the project or medium,
you’re sure to find something right here with us!

We have been incredibly lucky over the years to have built a loyal customer base of incredible
creatives with astonishing bodies of work. If you’d like, you’re always welcome to share with us,
whether that be via email, as one of our “featured artists”, through social media or even physically
in one of our stores, we’re always eager to see what you’ve made!

### Supplying Artists Everywhere

[down-arrow.svg]
[up-arrow.svg]

What’s more, we do our utmost to make sure you’re not sat around waiting for the materials for your
next project! We work hard to dispatch orders within 24hrs, with orders over £50 qualifying for free
standard UK Delivery (please check our Delivery Information page for all of the technical details!).

Just the same as in our shops, our website features a broad spectrum of materials & even some online
exclusive products not available in our stores, so keep an eye out for those!

Of course, if you find yourself in Shoreditch, Camberwell, Highbury or even Canterbury then why not
pop into one of our branches & speak with our colleagues? They’re always up for a chat, especially
to provide advice or recommendations!

[Red Paint] [Cowling and Wilcox Office]

Beginning life in the swinging Soho area of London in 1960, Cowling & Wilcox was born with a simple
ethos in mind; to provide the finest quality specialist materials for fine and graphic art at
exceptional prices.

Over 60 years later & not only are we still devoted to upholding this, but it remains our mission,
even as we expand & evolve into an ever more exciting future!

### Art Supplies & Product Range

[down-arrow.svg]
[up-arrow.svg]

Not only do we supply artists, but we ourselves are proudly creatively minded, meaning that over
these past 60 years, we’ve been on the pulse of trends, while accumulating an impressive wealth of
knowledge & expertise.

We have been stocking products from brands such as Winsor & Newton, Faber-Castell, Da Vinci,
Daler-Rowney & so many more for decades now, working diligently to not only to promote UK art brands
but to reach across the globe & broaden our respective horizons, bringing new materials to the
creative community right here!

On top of all of that, our range of materials is ever-growing, so no matter the project or medium,
you’re sure to find something right here with us!

We have been incredibly lucky over the years to have built a loyal customer base of incredible
creatives with astonishing bodies of work. If you’d like, you’re always welcome to share with us,
whether that be via email, as one of our “featured artists”, through social media or even physically
in one of our stores, we’re always eager to see what you’ve made!

### Supplying Artists Everywhere

[down-arrow.svg]
[up-arrow.svg]

What’s more, we do our utmost to make sure you’re not sat around waiting for the materials for your
next project! We work hard to dispatch orders within 24hrs, with orders over £50 qualifying for free
standard UK Delivery (please check our Delivery Information page for all of the technical details!).

Just the same as in our shops, our website features a broad spectrum of materials & even some online
exclusive products not available in our stores, so keep an eye out for those!

Of course, if you find yourself in Shoreditch, Camberwell, Highbury or even Canterbury then why not
pop into one of our branches & speak with our colleagues? They’re always up for a chat, especially
to provide advice or recommendations!

# Dedication to Quality

**Golden Paintworks**, a division of Golden Artist Colors Inc., operates under the same umbrella of
quality-minded research & development, manufacturing and attention to detail in the art materials
industry, but our focus is on **faux & decorative artisans, theme & scenic artists **and**
professional muralists**. 

**Specialty Paints, Textures, Mediums, Topcoats.** Products ready to use, or the starting point for
a wide range of decorative finishes.

**Theme Paints** and **Clears** formulated with advanced, exterior technologies for painting themed
facades, rock work and ride venues.

**Our Mural Paints** are designed for both indoor and outdoor mural use. 100% acrylic architectural
coating, formulated for clean, pure color.

Food, Feed & Pharma6 min

### [Essential Oils as Sustainable Animal Feed Ingredients][98]

[Calf eating feed from a blue trough while a farmer fills it in a modern livestock barn.]
Essential oils are gaining popularity across the feed industry as producers respond to regulatory
changes and sustainability requirements. The shift to essential oils reflects a move towards natural
feed additives that support modern feed strategies, while maintaining compliance with evolving
standards.
[ Read More ][99]
Coatings, Adhesives & Building6 min

### [A Low-CO₂ Revolution in Construction Chemicals][100]

[Worker preparing mortar at a construction site using composite cement and building construction
chemicals.]
This article examines the shift from pure cement (CEM I) to low-CO₂ composite cement (CEM II/III) in
the global construction industry. It looks at the challenges mortar producers face when
reformulating for lower clinker content and shows how building construction chemicals are essential
to maintaining performance.

### [Essential Oils as Sustainable Animal Feed Ingredients][98]

[Calf eating feed from a blue trough while a farmer fills it in a modern livestock barn.]
Essential oils are gaining popularity across the feed industry as producers respond to regulatory
changes and sustainability requirements. The shift to essential oils reflects a move towards natural
feed additives that support modern feed strategies, while maintaining compliance with evolving
standards.
[ Read More ][99]

### [A Low-CO₂ Revolution in Construction Chemicals][100]

[Worker preparing mortar at a construction site using composite cement and building construction
chemicals.]
This article examines the shift from pure cement (CEM I) to low-CO₂ composite cement (CEM II/III) in
the global construction industry. It looks at the challenges mortar producers face when
reformulating for lower clinker content and shows how building construction chemicals are essential
to maintaining performance.

Painting cabinets require a keen eye for detail, steady hands, and patience. There’s no need for you

## Get a free consultation

Customize your portrait, combine multiple pictures of your loved ones, your naughty pooch, and see
how it will look before you order. Let us know if you wish to rush through the order to receive it
by a particular date. Need suggestions on background? Or wish to give a unique gift skillfully
created only for the recipient? We are here to help.
* [Get free consultation][62]
* [Chat with us][63]

## We obsess over the details to make every artwork just perfect.

Over the years we have curated images of our customers, made artworks based upon the images and
created a line of unique heirloom artworks bringing people separated by time, distance or
generations together. Just let us know the outfits, theme and backgrounds you love and you will be
amazed how the entire family can add up and live together in the portrait.
Family pictures should live on your walls, and not on a USB or photo album.

How many times have you wanted to stay with 'just the digitals pictures or photographs', with full
intention of printing or framing them, but never did?
Or never found a perfect picture of your family together, the kids didn't smile, someone moved or
blinked their eyes, everyone lived in different cities or your pet never stayed in one place to get
the perfect shot? We can combine the pictures and make the artwork look like the picture you always
wanted.

[Read More][64]
* [CUSTOMER STORY 1][65]
* [CUSTOMER STORY 2][66]

Preserving a Piece of History

"Now I’ll see the tree every day in my home." - Bill L

For over 50 years, Bill passed the Holy Oak, a 600-year-old white oak tree in Basking Ridge, NJ. It
wasn’t just historic. It was personal. When the tree was taken down in 2016, he wanted more than a
memory. He wanted to see it again every day. He shared a photo, room colors, and a vision: a
textured oil painting that would bring the tree back to life. Our artist honored every detail, from
the quiet cemetery beneath it to the warm tones of its final autumn. Now, the Holy Oak stands once
again, not outside a church, but on canvas, in Bill’s home.

timeless. With thoughtful edits and reference images, we created a hand-painted portrait that
captured not just faces, but presence. A gift his mother would cherish and a memory that now lives
on their wall.

[Row of traditional brownstone townhouses on a sunny day, capturing the realism of staircases
leading to arched doorways and decorative iron railings.]
[A man in a cowboy hat and woman in a long dress share a realistic romantic kiss in a field at
sunset, with a dramatic sky in the background.]
[Two realistic, fluffy white dogs lying on a wooden floor, one wearing a black bow and the other

[A realistic depiction of a smiling woman with blonde hair embracing a brown and white horse that

Our realism paintings are skillfully hand-painted to capture the finest details. Whether it's a
family portrait, a beloved pet, or a quiet street you once called home, realism preserves it all
with depth, warmth, and unmatched clarity. Realist painters chose to depict everyday life exactly as
it is, painting it just as they see it.

directly at the viewer in a semi-impressionistic style.]
[View of a historic city in semi-impressionism style at sunset, featuring terracotta rooftops and
large domed structures under a vividly colored sky.]
[A painting rendered in a semi-impressionism style depicting a man in a red Ferrari racing suit
holding a trophy, with a racing car atop in a playful, examining pose.]

A soft blend of realism and creative expression, Semi-Impressionism captures emotion with a gentle,
painterly touch.

greenery under a clear sky.]
[Golden retriever wearing a bandana sits on grass in front of a fence with an impressionistic
painted smiley face.]

Expressive and timeless, Full Impressionism transforms your photo into a richly textured painting
filled with movement and emotion.

## Get a free consultation

Customize your portrait, combine multiple pictures of your loved ones, your naughty pooch, and see
how it will look before you order. Let us know if you wish to rush through the order to receive it
by a particular date. Need suggestions on background? Or wish to give a unique gift skillfully
created only for the recipient? We are here to help.

## We obsess over the details to make every artwork just perfect.

Over the years we have curated images of our customers, made artworks based upon the images and
created a line of unique heirloom artworks bringing people separated by time, distance or
generations together. Just let us know the outfits, theme and backgrounds you love and you will be
amazed how the entire family can add up and live together in the portrait.
Family pictures should live on your walls, and not on a USB or photo album.

How many times have you wanted to stay with 'just the digitals pictures or photographs', with full
intention of printing or framing them, but never did?
Or never found a perfect picture of your family together, the kids didn't smile, someone moved or
blinked their eyes, everyone lived in different cities or your pet never stayed in one place to get
the perfect shot? We can combine the pictures and make the artwork look like the picture you always
wanted.

[Read More][64]

* [CUSTOMER STORY 2][66]

Preserving a Piece of History

"Now I’ll see the tree every day in my home." - Bill L

For over 50 years, Bill passed the Holy Oak, a 600-year-old white oak tree in Basking Ridge, NJ. It
wasn’t just historic. It was personal. When the tree was taken down in 2016, he wanted more than a
memory. He wanted to see it again every day. He shared a photo, room colors, and a vision: a
textured oil painting that would bring the tree back to life. Our artist honored every detail, from
the quiet cemetery beneath it to the warm tones of its final autumn. Now, the Holy Oak stands once
again, not outside a church, but on canvas, in Bill’s home.

## Become a Member Today

From the very beginning, we knew that a brand would be nothing without its customer community.

And as Ohuhu hit its milestones of best-selling products, we never wanted to forget our roots and
why we do what we do- to empower the budding artist, the student who loves to create and everyone
else who just wants to paint up inspiration with quality art supplies.

Craft out beautiful landscapes on paper and expressing our creativity to the world. It was an
amazing feeling, and we wanted everyone to be able to enjoy these pockets of bliss. The easiest way
to do so? Through art supplies.

### If you want to go far, go together.

## Our Company

In the year 1968, under the stewardship of Mr. Pravinchandra B Shah, Vipul Group of companies began
its Napthol, Fast color bases and dye intermediates business. What began as a small venture,
expanded at a rapid pace and set up its manufacturing facility at Thane, outskirts of Mumbai.

Vipul Dye Chem was established in 1972, which was later renamed **Vipul Organics Limited**, to
reflect the product portfolio in the year 2017. Vipul Organics Limited is celebrating its Golden
Jubilee and is "50 years young" in the Color Industry.

In 1989, the second generation of the promoters, Mr. Vipul P Shah, joined the company, after
completing his Chemical Engineering. He was the one who really gave wings to the company's growth
story. **Vipul Organics** now also ventured into the pigments segment, making it a holistic Dyes and
Pigments company that has one-stop products and solutions for anything to do with the category.

### FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

1 What is the difference between dyes and pigments? +
Dyes are soluble colouring substances that chemically bond to the material they are applied to,
whereas pigments are insoluble particles that sit on the surface of a substrate held by a binder.
Dyes are widely used in textiles, while pigments are preferred in paints, inks, plastics, and
coatings where lightfastness and opacity are critical.
2 What industries use specialty dyes and organic pigments? +
Specialty dyes and organic pigments are used across a wide range of industries including textiles,
paints and coatings, printing inks, plastics and masterbatches, rubber and latex, agriculture (seed
colouring), leather, paper and packaging, food and beverages, cosmetics, and wood coatings.
3 What is backward-forward integration in pigment manufacturing? +
Backward-forward integration means a manufacturer controls the entire production chain — from making
raw dye intermediates, through to producing pigment powders, and finally manufacturing finished
pigment dispersions. This eliminates dependency on external suppliers, ensures consistent quality,
and results in more competitive pricing for buyers.
4 What certifications should I look for when sourcing dyes and pigments? +
When sourcing dyes and pigments, look for ISO certifications for quality management, REACH
compliance for European markets, APEO/NPEO-free and heavy metal-free certifications for eco-friendly
products, FDA approval for food and cosmetic colours, and compliance with Oeko-Tex or ZDHC standards
for textile applications.
5 Who are the leading dyes and pigments manufacturers and suppliers in India? +
India is home to several established dyes and pigments manufacturers and suppliers, with Mumbai and
Gujarat being the key hubs. Vipul Organics Ltd., founded in 1968 and operating with 6 manufacturing
units near Mumbai, is one of the most trusted names — offering a complete range of organic pigments,
reactive dyes, acid dyes, vat dyes, naphthols, fast color bases & salts, food colors, and dye
intermediates, and exporting to over 45 countries worldwide.

1 What is the difference between dyes and pigments? +
Dyes are soluble colouring substances that chemically bond to the material they are applied to,
whereas pigments are insoluble particles that sit on the surface of a substrate held by a binder.
Dyes are widely used in textiles, while pigments are preferred in paints, inks, plastics, and
coatings where lightfastness and opacity are critical.
2 What industries use specialty dyes and organic pigments? +
Specialty dyes and organic pigments are used across a wide range of industries including textiles,
paints and coatings, printing inks, plastics and masterbatches, rubber and latex, agriculture (seed
colouring), leather, paper and packaging, food and beverages, cosmetics, and wood coatings.
3 What is backward-forward integration in pigment manufacturing? +
Backward-forward integration means a manufacturer controls the entire production chain — from making
raw dye intermediates, through to producing pigment powders, and finally manufacturing finished
pigment dispersions. This eliminates dependency on external suppliers, ensures consistent quality,
and results in more competitive pricing for buyers.
4 What certifications should I look for when sourcing dyes and pigments? +
When sourcing dyes and pigments, look for ISO certifications for quality management, REACH
compliance for European markets, APEO/NPEO-free and heavy metal-free certifications for eco-friendly
products, FDA approval for food and cosmetic colours, and compliance with Oeko-Tex or ZDHC standards
for textile applications.
5 Who are the leading dyes and pigments manufacturers and suppliers in India? +
India is home to several established dyes and pigments manufacturers and suppliers, with Mumbai and
Gujarat being the key hubs. Vipul Organics Ltd., founded in 1968 and operating with 6 manufacturing
units near Mumbai, is one of the most trusted names — offering a complete range of organic pigments,
reactive dyes, acid dyes, vat dyes, naphthols, fast color bases & salts, food colors, and dye
intermediates, and exporting to over 45 countries worldwide.

Urban Outfitters US is a lifestyle retailer dedicated to inspiring customers through a unique
combination of product, creativity and cultural understanding. Founded in 1970 in a small space
across the street from the University of Pennsylvania, Urban Outfitters US now operates over 200
stores in the United States, Canada and Europe, offering experiential retail environments and a
well-curated mix of on-trend women’s and [men’s clothes][73], from boho dresses, denim and graphics
to shoes, hats, and backpacks, as well as beauty, [intimates][74], swim and a collection of
handpicked vintage clothing. Urban Outfitters also carries everything you need to decorate your
[small space][75], apartment or dorm, with a UO Home collection that includes [bedding][76],
tapestries, rugs, shower curtains and [furniture][77]. Our Music + Tech collection is a go-to
destination for vinyl, [record players][78] and tech accessories. Visit our stores, where all are
welcome and there’s always something new to see, or shop online at UrbanOutfitters.com and get free
shipping on qualifying US orders. For special offers, one-of-a-kind prizes and more, download the UO
US app and join [UO Rewards][79]! Want to be part of the conversation? Follow, share and shop
[@UrbanOutfitters][80].
